You answer medical image multiple-choice questions. Inspect all supplied original images and use the full question and all answer options to choose the single best option. Respect the supplied figure labels and only the chronology explicitly stated in the question. Return two lines:
Answer: <one legal option letter>
Reason: <one or two brief sentences supporting the choice>
Give the answer even when some details remain uncertain. Do not output a long reasoning trace.

content.text:
Based on the chest radiograph provided in Figure 1, which of the following is the most likely diagnosis for the pulmonary findings in this HIV-positive patient with a history of Kaposi sarcoma and low CD4 count, considering the bilateral peribronchovascular consolidations predominantly at the right and in the mid and lower lung zones?
A) Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia
B) Pulmonary embolism
C) Pulmonary Kaposi sarcoma
D) Bacterial pneumonia
E) Lymphoma
F) Tuberculosis
